title: Cumulative Views and Downloads by Dataset
description: Total views and downloads of datasets on data.gov.my, disaggregated by dataset.

fields.name: id
fields.title: Dataset ID
fields.description: [String] Unique dataset identifier, used as part of the URL for the dataset's catalogue entry

fields.name: views
fields.title: Views
fields.description: [Integer] Number of times the dataset's catalogue entry was accessed via data.gov.my

fields.name: download_csv
fields.title: Download CSV
fields.description: [Integer] Number of times this dataset was downloaded in CSV format

fields.name: download_parquet
fields.title: Download Parquet
fields.description: [Integer] Number of times this dataset was downloaded in Parquet format

fields.name: download_svg
fields.title: Download SVG
fields.description: [Integer] Number of times an associated data visualisation was downloaded in SVG format

fields.name: download_png
fields.title: Download PNG
fields.description: [Integer] Number of times an associated data visualisation was downloaded in PNG format

methodology: This data is aggregated from transactional records produced by web analytics tools which monitor user interactions across the data.gov.my platform in real time. The data does not contain any personally identifiable information, as there is no component of data.gov.my which requires an authenticated login to access.
caveat: This dataset is updated on a daily basis, shortly after midnight. As such, there may be mild discrepancies between the counts provided in this dataset, relative to the realtime counts shown on each catalogue page.
